claims.claim: HTML defines constraint validation for applicable form controls and exposes validity through APIs.
minlength does not itself make a control required; an optional field may be omitted.
checkValidity() evaluates constraints, while reportValidity() also asks the browser to report invalid controls.
Client-side validation improves user feedback but must not be trusted instead of server-side validation.
Accessible error feedback should identify the error in text and identify the affected control; color alone is insufficient.
Calling form.submit() bypasses constraint validation and does not fire the submit event.
